question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**evolve."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is regarding the book on computers.
 
• **In the sentence that contains the blank 5, the blank will imply the development that will happen from the exercises.**
 
• **"Evolve" is the correct answer because it is the verb form that fits grammatically in the blank space**.
 
 
• "Evolve" means to develop or to make something develop gradually, from a simple to a more advanced form.
 
 
 
• The word "evolving" (Option 1) is a present participle form, which would not fit in the blank space as it would require an auxiliary verb (e.g. "is evolving").
 
• "Evolved" (Option 2) is a past tense form, which also would not fit in the blank space as it would not match the tense of the surrounding words.
 
• "Evolution" (Option 3) is a noun form, which would not fit in the blank space as it does not function as a verb in this context.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Evolving" is the present participle form of "evolve", used to describe an ongoing process of change or development.
 
• Option 2: "Evolved" is the past tense form of "evolve", used to describe a completed process of change or development.
 
• Option 3: "Evolution" is a noun referring to the process of gradual change over time.
